rules.title: vCenter build is not exposed to known security advisories
rules.rationale: vCenter is the control plane for every host and VM; exploited vCenter vulnerabilities give full infrastructure compromise.

mitigation.summary: Patch vCenter to the fixed build.
steps: Patch via VAMI or vCenter Lifecycle Manager

rules.title: vCenter release is within vendor general support
rules.rationale: Unsupported releases no longer receive routine security fixes.

mitigation.summary: Upgrade vCenter to a supported release.

rules.title: Administrator role is granted to groups, not individual users
rules.rationale: Direct user grants bypass group lifecycle controls and complicate access reviews.

mitigation.summary: Replace user Admin grants with directory group grants.
steps: Administration > Access Control > Global Permissions / object Permissions

rules.title: vCenter permissions and roles are reviewed

check.guidance: Review custom roles, inherited permissions and global permissions for least privilege (privilege paths are shown in the report)

rules.rationale: Excess privilege on vCenter equals control over every workload.

mitigation.summary: Remove unneeded privileges and custom roles.

rules.title: vpxuser password rotation is 30 days or less
rules.rationale: vCenter uses the vpxuser account on every host; rotation limits the value of a stolen password.

rules.title: Event and task retention meets investigation needs
rules.rationale: Short retention destroys audit history needed for incident response.

mitigation.summary: Set event.maxAge / task.maxAge to at least 30 days and forward events to a SIEM.

rules.title: SSO password, lockout and token policies are reviewed

check.guidance: Review Single Sign-On password, lockout and token policies and identity sources (not exposed to the vSphere API)

rules.rationale: Weak SSO policy undermines every vCenter login.

mitigation.summary: Configure SSO policies per organizational standard.

rules.title: Appliance OS, SSH, backup and database controls are evidenced

check.guidance: Supply evidence for VCSA shell/SSH state, file-based backup schedule and restore tests, and appliance firewall

rules.rationale: Appliance-level hardening cannot be confirmed from vSphere inventory alone.

mitigation.summary: Disable appliance SSH, schedule backups and test restores.

rules.title: Key provider dependency is documented and redundant

check.guidance: Confirm key providers are redundant and not hosted solely on the infrastructure they protect

rules.rationale: Encrypted VMs cannot start if the key provider is unavailable.

mitigation.summary: Deploy redundant KMS nodes outside the protected cluster.

rules.title: vSphere HA is enabled
rules.rationale: Without HA, host failures cause prolonged workload outages.

rules.title: HA admission control is enabled
rules.rationale: Without admission control, the cluster may lack capacity to restart workloads after a failure.

mitigation.summary: Enable admission control with an appropriate policy.
steps: Cluster > Configure > vSphere Availability > Admission Control

rules.title: Cluster has at least two hosts
rules.rationale: A single-host cluster is a single point of failure.

mitigation.summary: Add hosts or accept the risk with an exception.

rules.title: DRS is enabled
rules.rationale: DRS supports maintenance evacuation, which enables timely patching.

rules.title: NFS datastores use Kerberos authentication
rules.rationale: AUTH_SYS NFS trusts client-asserted identities; anyone on the storage network can mount exports.

mitigation.summary: Use NFS 4.1 with Kerberos (krb5i) or isolate NFS on a dedicated non-routed network and record an exception.
steps: Remount with Kerberos after array configuration

rules.title: Datastore is accessible
rules.rationale: Inaccessible datastores indicate path or array failures affecting recovery.

mitigation.summary: Investigate storage paths and array health.

rules.title: vSAN data-at-rest encryption is enabled
rules.rationale: Protects data on failed or stolen drives.

mitigation.summary: Enable vSAN data-at-rest encryption with a redundant key provider.
steps: Cluster > Configure > vSAN > Services > Data Services

rules.title: vSAN data-in-transit encryption is enabled
rules.rationale: Protects replication traffic on the vSAN network.

rules.title: Backup and restore-test evidence exists

check.guidance: Import or attach backup job, retention and restore-test evidence with dates; snapshots and successful jobs are not proof of restore

rules.rationale: Recoverability is only demonstrated by tested restores.

mitigation.summary: Schedule and document restore tests for critical workloads and management components.
steps: Record restore-test evidence in the scope file

rules.title: SAN resources are segregated (zoning/LUN masking)

check.guidance: Review SAN zoning and LUN masking evidence from the storage fabric

rules.rationale: Improper zoning exposes datastores to unauthorized initiators.

mitigation.summary: Apply single-initiator zoning and LUN masking.
